name: Okaa-san no Ama Ama Time ~Musuko no Yokubou~
original_name: お母さんの甘々タイム ～息子の欲望～
source:
The protagonist lacks confidence in dating women. In order to help him, his mother tries to build his confidence by using her own body.

She begins by caressing his chest, neck, and secret place, and he feels an uncontrollable desire for her.
